name: bld_surjective_nonexpanding_compact_isometry
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hs : Function.Surjective f) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) : Isometry f
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hs : Function.Surjective f) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y), Isometry f
informal: Uses Mathlib2.top_expanding_compact_isometry and Mathlib2.top_isometry_compact_surjective: a right inverse g of f is expanding, hence an isometry by the first theorem and surjective by the second; so g is a bijective isometry and f = g⁻¹ is an isometry.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), Function.Surjective f → (∀ (x y : X), dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) → Isometry f
